assumptions.source: <the input concept verbatim: a surfaces[].name entry, a persistence concept, a flow, or 'baseline rule' - NEVER a file name: only metadata.inputs may cite files>

entries.surface: <a strategy surfaces[].name, copied VERBATIM - this is the join key>
entries.driver: <arrival rate / payload / fan-out / data volume, one sentence; when the description omits the number cite the baseline assumption ('per PA-01') - never halt the run for a missing number>

surfaces_exempt.reason: <why it carries no load duty - silence is not a decision>

measurement.assertion: <what a stage-1 test observes WITHOUT a clock or a load harness>

invariants.rule: <what holds at worst case, one sentence>
invariants.owner_context: <a strategy bounded_contexts name, exactly as spelled, or omit>

duties.obligation: <one sentence: what a unit must hold>

risks.risk: <exposure the plan refuses to soften away>
risks.mitigation: <an id this spec declares> OR accepted:|none:|operator:|out-of-scope: <posture>
risks.residual: <what stays exposed; required for accepted postures>

open_questions: <anything an input never declared - an entry here STOPS the run>
